definitions.explanation: The formal ceremony celebrating a marriage.

examples.japanese: {結婚式|けっこんしき}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
{結婚式|けっこんしき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{招待|しょうたい}された→招待：01435_shoutai⟧。
examples.english: I was invited to the wedding.

examples.japanese: ⟦{教会|きょうかい}→教会：01387_kyoukai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{結婚式|けっこんしき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{挙|あ}げた→挙げる：27889_ageru⟧。
examples.english: We had our wedding ceremony at a church.

notes:
{結婚式|けっこんしき} refers to the formal wedding ceremony itself. In Japan, the ceremony ({結婚式|けっこんしき}) is usually followed by a reception (⟦{披露宴|ひろうえん}→披露宴：05636_hirouen⟧), which are often treated as separate events.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {結婚式|けっこんしき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{挙|あ}げる→挙げる：27889_ageru⟧: to hold a wedding ceremony
- {結婚式|けっこんしき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出席|しゅっせき}する→出席：02084_shusseki⟧: to attend a wedding
- {結婚式|けっこんしき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{招待|しょうたい}する→招待：01435_shoutai⟧: to invite to a wedding
- ⟦{結婚式場|けっこんしきじょう}→結婚式場：30785_kekkonshikijou⟧: wedding venue

TYPES:
- ⟦{神前式|しんぜんしき}→神前式：28943_shinzenshiki⟧: Shinto-style wedding (at a shrine)
- ⟦{教会式|きょうかいしき}→教会式：28944_kyoukaishiki⟧: church-style wedding (most popular style)
- ⟦{人前式|じんぜんしき}→人前式：28945_jinzenshiki⟧: secular ceremony (vows before guests)

RELATED TERMS:
- ⟦{披露宴|ひろうえん}→披露宴：05636_hirouen⟧: wedding reception (formal banquet)
- ⟦{二次会|にじかい}→二次会：08355_nijikai⟧: casual after-party
- ⟦ご{祝儀|しゅうぎ}→祝儀：06225_shuugi⟧: monetary gift (typically given in odd-numbered amounts like 30,000 or 50,000 yen)
